name: planet-born-before-you
description: كوكب يولد أمامك — Planet Born Before You

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" build && pnpm --filter @planet/api build && pnpm --filter @planet/web build && pnpm --filter @planet/admin build
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" test && pnpm --filter @planet/api test && cd services/simulation-engine && python3 -m pytest -q
scripts.check: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" exec tsc --noEmit --if-present; pnpm --filter @planet/api exec tsc --noEmit; pnpm --filter @planet/web exec tsc --noEmit; pnpm --filter @planet/admin exec tsc --noEmit
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
